Tests that WebMCP.invokeTool with the toolId of a tool the client previously observed fails once that tool is replaced by a different tool with the same name, while invoking by (deprecated) toolName executes the replacement.
Enabling WebMCP Domain
Observed tool: swapped_tool (the original tool)
Unregistering it and registering a new tool with the same name...
New tool: swapped_tool (a different tool that reused the name)
The new tool has a different toolId
Invoking the observed tool by toolId...
invokeTool error: Tool not found
Executed tools: []
Invoking the observed tool by (deprecated) toolName...
toolResponded: status=Completed, output=replacement
Executed tools: [replacement]
